_doc: Harness defaults. save: the map name in a save's caption (caption.sav), as Area/Map or just Map; the newest save with it is loaded (the Load list is newest first). expect_spawn: where Link must stand after the load, or null to skip the check. save_index: set to a number (0 = newest) to pick that Load-list position instead of looking up save by name. session_name: shown in the Lichii window title with the scenario, attempt and step.
